lines.en: label makotopool55:
scene makotomikupool1

I make my way over to the pool to spend some time with two girls I will one day have a threesome with because, despite Makoto showing no interest in doing that with Miku, we all know it will happen one day.
lines.zh: 我走到泳池边，打算和两个我总有一天会跟她们来一发三人行的女孩待一会儿——因为尽管 Makoto 对和 Miku 一起做这事毫无兴趣，我们心里都清楚，那一天迟早会来。

lines.en: I mean, just look at them. Those are the faces of two best friends who are longing to share the same penis.
lines.zh: 我是说，看看她们俩吧。那分明是两个好闺蜜渴望共享同一根阴茎的脸。

lines.en: But I digress.
lines.zh: 不过我跑题了。

lines.en: The {i}real{/i} reason I’m here is to see if Makoto is still sticking to her “Live because others want you to” plan or however it was she worded it on the rooftop the other day.
lines.zh: 我{i}真正{/i}来这儿的目的，是想看看 Makoto 是不是还在坚持她那个「因为别人希望你好好活着，所以活下去」的计划——或者不管那天在天台上她是怎么说的来着。

lines.en: It’s admirable. {i}Foolish,{/i} but admirable.
lines.zh: 这很了不起。{i}愚蠢{/i}，但了不起。

lines.en: It’s important to note, however, that I am a man who is living almost entirely for his self, so I am very likely a bit biased.
lines.zh: 不过需要说明的是，我这个人几乎完全是为自己活的，所以我的看法八成有点偏。

lines.en: I guess what really matters at the end of the day is that Makoto stays grounded. {i}How{/i} she does that is up to her. Just like {i}how much she enjoys it{/i} is up to her as well (depression aside).
lines.zh: 我想，归根结底真正要紧的是 Makoto 能保持脚踏实地。至于{i}怎么做到{/i}，那是她自己的事。就像她能从中获得{i}多少乐趣{/i}，也全看她自己（抑郁症另说）。

lines.en: Moving forward is a good place to start.
lines.zh: 往前走，是个不错的开始。

lines.en: I just hope she doesn’t wind up walking around in circles.
lines.zh: 我只希望她别到最后只是绕着圈子原地打转。

lines.en: : Hello, ladies.
lines.zh: : 你们好啊，女士们。

lines.en: scene makotomikupool2
: Uhh...hello {i}Sir?{/i}
lines.zh: : 呃……您好，{i}先生{/i}？

lines.en: : Sensei! Been meanin’ to call ya! Congratulations!
lines.zh: : Sensei！我一直都想着要给你打电话呢！恭喜恭喜！

lines.en: : For what? What did I do?
lines.zh: : 恭喜什么？我做了什么？

lines.en: scene makotomikupool3
: Ya finally locked lips with my BFF after a billion years, that’s what! Took ya long enough, you sly dog.
lines.zh: : 你俩过了整整一万年，总算亲上嘴了呗！可真够慢的，你这只老狐狸。

lines.en: : Oh, good. So it appears that Makoto is just as open about our relationship behind closed doors as you.
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了。看来 Makoto 在私下里谈起我们的关系时，跟你一样坦荡。

lines.en: : That’s what best friends are for. Duh. ‘Sides, you two’ve already done the nasty a good hundred times by now. Kissin’ ain’t nothin’.
lines.zh: : 好朋友不就是干这个的嘛。废话。再说了，你俩到现在那个啥都做了得有一百回了。亲嘴算个啥。

lines.en: : Seems like a lot to Makoto based on her reaction.
lines.zh: : 看 Makoto 的反应，这事对她来说可不小。

lines.en: : Oh, you know...It was only something I was looking forward to for...practically forever.
lines.zh: : 哦，你知道的……那不过是我盼了……几乎一辈子的事而已。

lines.en: : How’d ya do it? Tongue? No tongue? She good? Better than me?
lines.zh: : 你俩怎么亲的？伸舌头没？没伸？她厉害吗？比我强？

lines.en: : I have no further interest in discussing this with you, Miku.
lines.zh: : 我没兴趣再跟你讨论下去了，Miku。

lines.en: scene makotomikupool4
: Guh. You men and your damn secrets.
lines.zh: : 切。你们男人和你那该死的秘密。

lines.en: : I haven’t told anyone else. Don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 我还没跟别人说过。别担心。

lines.en: : Who else would you even tell? Your mom?
lines.zh: : 你还能告诉谁？你妈？

lines.en: scene makotomikupool5
: I have other friends! Touka and I hang out sometimes! And I’ve come over to your house on several occasions just to see Ami!
lines.zh: : 我还有别的朋友！我和 Touka 有时候也会一起玩！而且我还好几次专门去你家找 Ami 呢！

lines.en: : Oh, maybe {i}I{/i} should tell Maki we’re a thing now? She could probably give me all sortsa cool sex tips.
lines.zh: : 哦，那{i}我{/i}是不是该告诉 Maki 你俩现在好上了？她说不定能给我一堆超酷的性爱小技巧。

lines.en: : Miku, apart from Makoto, just never tell anyone about anything we do ever. Okay?
lines.zh: : Miku，除了 Makoto，我们做的任何事都永远别告诉任何人。明白吗？

lines.en: : Not even if it means missin’ out on cool sex tips?
lines.zh: : 就算会错过超酷的性爱小技巧也不行？

lines.en: : I can assure you that Makoto can give you all of the “cool sex tips” you need.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，Makoto 能给你的「超酷性爱小技巧」够你用的了。

lines.en: scene makotomikupool6
: Do you know how to do that thing where you unlock your jaw? Can you teach me? That sounds useful.
lines.zh: : 你知道怎么把下巴脱臼那个技巧吗？能教我吗？听起来挺有用的。

lines.en: : Sure. Just as soon as Sensei remembers that I’m the one who’s supposed to be bullying him now.
lines.zh: : 当然。等 Sensei 想起来现在该由我来欺负他的时候再说。

lines.en: : Hey, don’t get mad at me. This is almost entirely Miku’s fault.
lines.zh: : 嘿，别冲我发火。这事几乎全怪 Miku。

lines.en: : The reason I wanna know how to do the jaw thing is cause-
lines.zh: : 我想知道下巴那个技巧，是因为——

lines.en: scene makotomikupool7
: You don’t have to tell me {i}everything,{/i} Miku! Come on!
lines.zh: : 你不用{i}什么都{/i}跟我说，Miku！拜托！

lines.en: : Well ‘scuse me for wantin’ to cash in on the cool sex tips I was promised.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，不好意思啊，我还想把说好给我的酷炫性爱技巧兑换了呢。

lines.en: : There’s nothing I can teach you that the Internet can’t! These are things you can look up on your own time!
lines.zh: : 我能教你的，网上没有找不到的！这种事你自己抽空查查就行了！

lines.en: : Time?! But I barely have any time to-
lines.zh: : 时间？！可我根本没时间——

lines.en: scene makotomikupool8
: Oh, crap.
lines.zh: : 哦，糟了。

lines.en: : Crap? Why crap?
lines.zh: : 糟了？怎么糟了？

lines.en: : I, uhh...
scene makotomikupool9
: I was supposed to meet up with Kirin to do some study thing! Because, you know, I’m an idiot.
lines.zh: : 我本来约好了要和 Kirin 一起搞什么学习小组的！因为，你知道的，我是个笨蛋。

lines.en: : What do you have to study for? We just finished all of our testing. Also, why didn’t you ask me?
lines.zh: : 你有什么好复习的？我们刚把所有考试都考完了。还有，你为什么不来问我？

lines.en: : Cause...you’re too hard on me. And Kirin ain’t that smart either, so...I’m just gonna go do stuff with her.
lines.zh: : 因为……你对我太凶了。而且 Kirin 也没那么聪明，所以……我还是跟她一起混吧。

lines.en: : Then...let me get dressed and I’ll come with you. I don’t have work tonight so-
lines.zh: : 那……等我换好衣服，我跟你一起去。我今晚不用上班，所以——

lines.en: scene makotomikupool10
: Nah, nah...don’t even worry about it. I’ll get outta your hair so you and Sensei can have some more alone time.
lines.zh: : 别别别……别管了。我不打扰你们了，好让你和 Sensei 多来点二人世界。

lines.en: : I really don’t mind-
lines.zh: : 我真的不介意——

lines.en: scene makotomikupool11
: Go easy on ‘er, ya hear? No grabbin’ where the sun don’t shine in public places.
lines.zh: : 对她温柔点，听见没？公共场合别乱摸太阳照不到的地方。

lines.en: : Tell Io I said hi.
lines.zh: : 替我向 Io 问好。

lines.en: scene makotomikupool12
: It’s...Kirin.
lines.zh: : 是……Kirin。

lines.en: scene makotomikupool13
Miku scampers off and, unfortunately, I have a pretty good idea of where she’s going.
lines.zh: Miku 蹦蹦跳跳地跑掉了，而不幸的是，我很清楚她要去哪儿。

lines.en: : Io?
lines.zh: : Io？

lines.en: : Why would Miku be going to see Io?
lines.zh: : Miku 为什么要去找 Io？

lines.en: scene makotomikupool14
: Maybe there’s something Io can do for her that no one else can?
lines.zh: : 也许 Io 有什么别人做不到的事能帮到她？

lines.en: : You mean, like...woodwork?
lines.zh: : 你是说，比如……木工？

lines.en: : Exactly, Makoto. Miku is secretly into woodwork, but is extremely embarrassed about it. Also, how do you even know Io is into that sort of thing?
lines.zh: : 正是，Makoto。Miku 偷偷迷上了木工，而且对此极度难为情。还有，你是怎么知道 Io 好这口的？

lines.en: scene makotomikupool15
: I’ve had to give her the key to the woodshop on several occasions now. Also, anyone could tell she spends her free time on {i}something{/i} physical just by looking at her hands.
lines.zh: : 我已经好几次不得不把木工教室的钥匙给她了。而且，光看她的手，谁都能看出来她空闲时间都在干{i}体力活{/i}。

lines.en: : What does any of that have to do with Miku, though? Why would you assume she’s hanging out with Io?
lines.zh: : 可这跟 Miku 有什么关系？你凭什么觉得她是跟 Io 混在一起？

lines.en: : I don’t know if they’re “hanging out.” I just know she goes to see her sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我不知道她们算不算「混在一起」。我只知道她有时候会去找她。

lines.en: : For...wood?
lines.zh: : 为了……木头？

lines.en: : Yes.
scene makotomikupool16
: Sensei, what’s going on? Because between this and that weird “joke” you made when the two of us came over to play games, I’m starting to feel really weird.
lines.zh: : Sensei，到底怎么回事？这件事，加上上次我们俩去你家打游戏时你开的那个奇怪的「玩笑」，让我开始觉得很不舒服。

lines.en: : I’ve also noticed that Miku’s been a little different than normal lately, so if you have any sort of insight into that, I’d greatly appreciate it.
lines.zh: : 我还注意到 Miku 最近有点跟平时不一样，所以如果你对此有什么了解，我会非常感激。

lines.en: : Weird how? What’s different about her?
lines.zh: : 怎么个怪法？她哪里不一样了？

lines.en: scene makotomikupool17
: Nothing...{i}bad{/i} I guess. Just different. Maybe a little more focused and...less...{i}Miku-{/i}ish?
lines.zh: : 也没什么……{i}不好的{/i}吧。就是不一样。也许是更专注了一点，而且……没那么……{i}Miku{/i} 了？

lines.en: : So...more like a normal girl?
lines.zh: : 所以……更像个正常女孩了？

lines.en: : Like I said, it’s not {i}bad.{/i} She’s just seemed a little...off. But I don’t see what that has to do with Io.
lines.zh: : 我说了，这不是{i}坏事{/i}。她只是看起来有点……怪怪的。可我看不出这跟 Io 有什么关系。

lines.en: : Then ask her. It’s not my place to reveal all of Miku’s secrets, but I’ll be damned if I don’t repeatedly hint at them until you do something about it yourself.
lines.zh: : 那就去问她。我没资格把 Miku 的所有秘密都抖出来，但在你自己动手之前，我会一遍又一遍地暗示，绝不含糊。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...I’m barely in the position to do that when I know I’ve probably been exactly the same as her.
lines.zh: : 嗯，好吧……我自己大概跟她一模一样，哪还有什么立场去做那件事。

lines.en: scene black
Makoto pulls herself out of the pool and grabs a towel off a nearby rack to dry herself off before heading over to a bench.
lines.zh: Makoto 从泳池里爬上来，从旁边的架子上抓起一条毛巾擦干身子，然后走向一张长椅。

lines.en: scene makotomikupool18
As I join her on said bench, I need to once again remind myself of how annoyed I am by those who meddle in {i}my{/i} affairs and that I’d be no better than them by following in their footsteps.
lines.zh: 我在那张长椅上挨着她坐下时，得再提醒自己一次：那些爱管{i}我{/i}闲事的人让我有多烦，而我要是跟着他们的步子走，也不比他们好到哪去。

lines.en: It would be different to directly involve myself with {i}Makoto’s{/i} affairs, though...wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: 不过，直接插手 {i}Makoto 的{/i}事，那就不一样了……不是吗？

lines.en: Doesn’t she {i}want{/i} me to get involved with her problems? Isn’t that why she didn’t oppose me sitting down beside her?
lines.zh: 她不是{i}希望{/i}我介入她的烦恼吗？她没反对我坐到她旁边，不就是这个原因？

lines.en: This isn’t like the Miku thing at all. Whatever is going on {i}now{/i} is something that I’m a part of.
lines.zh: 这跟 Miku 那件事完全不一样。{i}现在{/i}发生的这些，我也是其中的一部分。

lines.en: : Maybe it’s just stress.
lines.zh: : 也许只是压力吧。

lines.en: Or maybe whatever is going on {i}now{/i} is much smaller than I anticipated-
lines.zh: 又或者，{i}现在{/i}发生的这些，比我预想的要小得多——

lines.en: And these rare worries of mine were all for nothing.
lines.zh: 而我这些难得的担忧，全都是白操心。

lines.en: : Stress?
lines.zh: : 压力？

lines.en: : The feeling of emotional or physical tension.
lines.zh: : 情绪上或身体上的紧张感。

lines.en: : I know what stress is, Makoto. I was asking why you’d think that.
lines.zh: : 我知道压力是什么，Makoto。我问的是你为什么会这么想。

lines.en: : I get that you have plenty on your plate, but what does Miku have to be stressed about?
lines.zh: : 我知道你身上压着一堆事，可 Miku 有什么好有压力的？

lines.en: : Lack of purpose. Bad grades. Diving into a sexually active life despite barely any prior knowledge and zero experience. Romance as a whole. The weight of competition.
lines.zh: : 没有目标。成绩差。在几乎零知识、零经验的情况下一头扎进活跃的性生活。恋爱这整件事。竞争带来的重压。

lines.en: : There’s plenty for Miku to be stressed about. But, even if there wasn’t, it could still very well {i}be{/i} that.
lines.zh: : Miku 有的是可以发愁的事。不过就算没有，也完全{i}可能是{/i}压力。

lines.en: : You never need a reason to be stressed. Some people simply just {i}are.{/i}
lines.zh: : 有压力从来不需要理由。有些人天生{i}就是这样{/i}。

lines.en: : Is there...anything I can do to help with that?
lines.zh: : 有没有……我能帮上忙的地方？

lines.en: scene makotomikupool19
: Help {i}me?{/i} Or Miku? Which one are we talking about?
lines.zh: : 帮{i}我{/i}？还是帮 Miku？我们说的是哪个？

lines.en: : You.
: Probably. Have you progressed past the point where your go-to solution is to just {i}massage{/i} the stress out of me?
lines.zh: : 大概有吧。你已经不再是那个一上来就想着靠{i}按摩{/i}把我的压力揉出去的人了吧？

lines.en: : I think so. I’m a lot different now than I was back then.
lines.zh: : 我觉得是。我现在跟那时候比，变了很多。

lines.en: : Good. Because, in hindsight, that was very creepy. And if I didn’t spend so much time fantasizing about that exact scenario, I probably would have filed a complaint.
lines.zh: : 那就好。因为回想起来，那真的挺恶心的。要不是我花了那么多时间幻想那个场景，我大概早就去投诉了。

lines.en: : Just tell me what I can do, Makoto. I’m tired of letting you handle all of this on your own and I really do want to be better to you.
lines.zh: : 直接告诉我我能做什么吧，Makoto。我不想再让你一个人扛着这些了，我是真的想对你更好一点。

lines.en: scene makotomikupool20
: That’s...really sweet, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这……真的很贴心，Sensei。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, I don’t think there’s much you can do.
lines.zh: : 可惜，我觉得你大概帮不上什么忙。

lines.en: : Like I said the other day, this is just...kind of how I exist now. I’m a big, tense bottle of anguish and despair- emptied only by the hand of fate itself.
lines.zh: : 就像我那天说的，这就是……我现在存在的方式吧。我是个紧绷的大瓶子，里面装满了痛苦和绝望——只有命运之手才能把它倒空。

lines.en: scene makotomikupool21
: I’ve taken some big steps lately, though.
lines.zh: : 不过，我最近迈出了几大步。

lines.en: : In fact, the vast majority of what I’ve said to you over the last few days has been the result of a lot of hard work and lot of...really difficult conversations.
lines.zh: : 事实上，这几天我跟你说的绝大多数话，都是下了很大功夫、经历了很多……非常艰难的对话才说出口的。

lines.en: : My mom and Miku did a lot for me when I was struggling. I know that...But I think Ami and Touka were the ones who helped me more than anyone.
lines.zh: : 我挣扎的时候，妈妈和 Miku 为我做了很多。这我知道……但我觉得，帮我的最多的还是 Ami 和 Touka。

lines.en: : It was kind of like therapy in a way. Touka allowed me to vent and Ami taught me new ways to cope and helped me better understand the world I’m in now.
lines.zh: : 某种程度上，那有点像心理治疗。Touka 让我把情绪发泄出来，Ami 教给我新的应对方式，还帮我更好地理解了我现在所处的世界。

lines.en: : Why not...go to actual therapy?
lines.zh: : 为什么不……真的去做心理咨询呢？

lines.en: scene makotomikupool22
: I think I might. We have good insurance, so I’d be able to see someone without it being a financial burden. I’ve just always felt weird about things like that.
lines.zh: : 我想我会的。我们的保险不错，去看医生不会造成经济负担。我只是对这种事一直觉得别扭。

lines.en: : That’s because you’re like me. You bottle things up until there’s nowhere else to put them.
lines.zh: : 那是因为你跟我一样。你把所有东西都往瓶子里塞，直到再也塞不进去。

lines.en: : How have you managed to go so long without bursting, Sensei? I’m really curious.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你是怎么撑这么久都没炸的？我真的很好奇。

lines.en: : Between the coping techniques and emotional outbursts, Ami also helped me realize just how hard you were hit when-
lines.zh: : 在各种应对技巧和情绪爆发之间，Ami 还让我意识到，你当时受到的打击有多大——

lines.en: scene makotomikupool23
: I’ve managed to go so long by doing the exact opposite of what you’ve been doing. And, sorry for interrupting, but I don’t think I’m going to change that just by hearing about your success.
lines.zh: : 我能撑这么久，靠的是跟你做的完全相反。还有，抱歉打断一下，但我不觉得光听你讲你的成功，我就会改变。

lines.en: : That doesn’t stop me from being happy for you, though.
lines.zh: : 不过，这不妨碍我为你高兴。

lines.en: : What if it’s me?
lines.zh: : 如果是我呢？

lines.en: : What if {i}what{/i} is you?
lines.zh: : 如果{i}什么{/i}是你？

lines.en: : What if you talk to {i}me{/i} about your feelings? I can be your Ami. Or your Touka.
lines.zh: : 如果是让{i}我{/i}来听你说你的感受呢？我可以当你的 Ami。或者你的 Touka。

lines.en: : I already have an Ami {i}and{/i} a Touka and I wouldn’t want to talk about this with either of them.
lines.zh: : 我已经有一个 Ami {i}和{/i}一个 Touka 了，而且这件事我谁都不想跟她们谈。

lines.en: : I won’t force you, of course. The unending weight of “opening up” is still fresh on my mind after the lot of you barraged me at the height of my misery.
lines.zh: : 我当然不会逼你。在我最痛苦的时候你们一窝蜂地围上来，那种「敞开心扉」的无尽重压，我到现在还记得清清楚楚。

lines.en: : In fact, I won’t even tell you that I’ll be here for you if you {i}want{/i} to open up as I’m sure I’ve said that many times in the past...and that it’s already ingrained into your mind.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我甚至不会再对你说「如果你{i}想{/i}倾诉，我随时都在」——这种话我过去肯定说过很多次了……也早就刻进你脑子里了。

lines.en: : But if you ever start ranting, I won’t stop you.
lines.zh: : 但如果你哪天开始发泄，我不会拦你。

lines.en: : And if you ever want me to be more for you than I already am, I will.
lines.zh: : 如果你想让我为你承担比现在更多的身份，我也会。

lines.en: : With all due respect, there are at least ten other girls who would say the same exact thing to me right now.
lines.zh: : 恕我直言，现在至少有十个别的女孩会对我说一模一样的话。

lines.en: : That might be true.
lines.zh: : 这倒可能是真的。

lines.en: scene makotomikupool24
: But none of them are me. And, all things considered, I think I’m pretty awesome.
lines.zh: : 可她们都不是我。而且，综合来看，我觉得我挺棒的。

lines.en: : Plus, I know I’ve locked down a special place somewhere in your heart even if you won’t admit it.
lines.zh: : 再说，我知道自己早就在你心里的某个角落占了个特殊的位置，就算你不承认。

lines.en: : Like it or not, the two of us are in this thing together — and we can empty out each other’s bottles whenever we get full since we’re too stubborn to empty them out ourselves.
lines.zh: : 不管你愿不愿意，我们两个是绑在这件事里的——等彼此的瓶子满了，就替对方倒空，因为我们自己都太倔，不肯倒。

lines.en: : Thanks Makoto, but...this is a little bit nicer than you’re supposed to be acting toward me now.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Makoto，不过……你现在对我的态度，比规定里的要好上一点了。

lines.en: : You’re right. Give me all your lunch money.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。把你午饭钱都交出来。

lines.en: scene makotomikupool25
: That’s more like it. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 这才像话。谢了。

lines.en: : Whatever you need. And I’m not just saying that as your secretary slash assistant slash friend slash girlfriend slash fuck buddy slash porno clerk.
lines.zh: : 你需要什么我都给。我这话可不只是以你的秘书／助手／朋友／女朋友／炮友／色情店店员的身份说的。

lines.en: : Then that leaves...
lines.zh: : 那剩下的就是……

lines.en: : Just Makoto.
lines.zh: : 只是 Makoto。

lines.en: scene black
: And whatever you want me to be next.
lines.zh: : 还有，你接下来想让我成为什么，我就是什么。

lines.en: The next half hour goes by without much conversation before Makoto has to take off for another “therapy” session with my niece.
lines.zh: 接下来的半个钟头没怎么说话，Makoto 就动身去和我侄女进行又一次「心理治疗」了。

lines.en: Everything she said today, I already knew.
lines.zh: 她今天说的这些，我早就知道。

lines.en: But there was something different about the way she said it that makes her feel like a brand new person.
lines.zh: 可她说这些话的方式有些不一样，让她感觉像换了一个人。

lines.en: And I don’t know what to make her next.
lines.zh: 而我不知道该让她成为下一个什么。

lines.en: But whatever it is, I hope it’s a role that makes her feel like she’s doing a little more than just “existing.”
lines.zh: 但不管是什么，我希望那是一个能让她觉得自己在做的、不只是「活着」而已的角色。
